description:
[Merchant] Simulate callback scenarios for testing webhook handling.

Generates the payload a merchant's `callbackUrl` actually receives, so a handler can be built and
tested against the real shape. Four properties of that shape are easy to get wrong:

**1. Absent means absent, not zero.** The payload omits properties with no value rather than sending
`null` or `0`. `statusMessage`, `passbackParams`, `fee`, `feeFixed` and `feeRate` are all simply
missing when they do not apply. A missing `fee` means the fee is *unknown* for that transaction - it
does not mean the transaction was free. Do not write a handler that reads `payload.fee` as a number
without checking it is there.

**2. `finalized` is absent on EXPIRED.** An expired transaction is closed by the platform's expiry
sweep, which sets no finalization moment. Every other status carries one.

**3. `EXPIRED` is a non-payment, not a failure.** The payer never paid within `timeToLive`. Release
the order or the stock, as you would for a cancellation - do not treat it as an error to retry.

**4. Deduplicate on `(transactionId, callbackType)`.** payware retries a callback up to 15 times,
backing off from about a second to at most 5 minutes between attempts, until the endpoint answers any
2xx. That pair is stable across every retry of the same event, and it is the key payware guarantees.
A handler that does not deduplicate will eventually process one payment twice.

**Payments with a product, a placement, a session or lines.** The payload also carries, when they apply and absent otherwise: `productId` (the product the payment came from), `placementId` (the placement it is attributed to, Premium only), `sessionId` (the purchase session's pa id) and `items` with their `total` (type, productId, name, quantity, unitPrice, amount, and country on a delivery line payware priced; no images). `total` is the sum of the lines, what was sold. **A tip is never a line**: the payload carries it as `tip` (absent without one), yours, sent when you created the payment, or the payer's, added in their bank where your shop allows tips; the payer paid `total` + `tip` and the fee applies to the whole of it. On CONFIRMED `amount` is net of the fee, so **`amount` + `fee` = `total` + `tip`**; on any other status nothing was paid and `amount` equals `total` + `tip`. Give `items` (and `tip`) and leave `amount` out: the tool works it out, and refuses an `amount` the server would never send with those lines.

**Not on this payload:** `deliveryAddress` (removed 2026-08-07 - fetch it from
`payware_operations_get_transaction_history`, which is authenticated and tenant-scoped),
`producerPartnerId`, `transactionType` and `initiatedBy` (the last two are carried on
TRANSACTION_PROCESSED, which merchants do not receive).

amount.description: Transaction amount (e.g., '57.60'; that is the default without items). With items leave it out: on CONFIRMED it is total minus fee, on any other status the total; a different value is refused

callbackUrl.description: URL where callback would be sent (for simulation only)

fee.description: payware's fee on this transaction plus VAT where it applies, at the currency's smallest payable unit (e.g. '0.29'). The payer's institution transfers it to payware alongside the merchant's payment, and amount is net of it. Not always two decimals - it follows the currency. Pass null to model the anomaly case, where a transaction has no recorded fee and the server OMITS the property entirely; that is deliberately distinguishable from a genuine '0.00'.

feeFixed.description: Fixed fee component of the applicable fee configuration, e.g. '0.1000'. Informational, for reconciliation. Present on FINALIZED callbacks since 2026-08-21 - before that a merchant got the total fee but not the breakdown that produced it. Pass null to model a transaction with no fee configuration, where it is omitted.

feeRate.description: Variable rate of the applicable fee configuration, e.g. '0.0150' = 1.5%. Informational, same as feeFixed. Pass null to model a transaction with no fee configuration.

feeVat.description: The VAT included in fee (fee minus feeVat is payware's fee excluding VAT), at the same scale; zero when no VAT applies (reverse charge, or a merchant outside the EU). Present exactly when fee is (server TransactionCallbackPayload). Defaults to zero.

items.description: Lines of a payment that has them (a product payment with a quantity, a purchase session, a merchant payment created with items): the callback then carries items and their total (the sum of the lines: what was sold). Each line: type (ITEM, SHIPPING, DISCOUNT, TAX or SURCHARGE), name, amount, and for an ITEM productId, quantity and unitPrice, for a SHIPPING line payware priced the country (a merchant's own lines carry none). A tip is never a line: give it as tip. Callback lines carry no images or terms. With items, leave amount out: on CONFIRMED it is worked out as total + tip minus fee, on any other status it is total + tip.

amount.description: The line total, a decimal string; negative only on a DISCOUNT

country.description: SHIPPING lines payware priced: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the delivery. A merchant's own lines carry none

name.description: What the line is. A payware-priced delivery line is named "Delivery"

productId.description: ITEM lines of payware products: the product id (pr + 8 characters)

unitPrice.description: ITEM lines: price of one unit, a decimal string

paymentMethod.description: Payment method chosen by customer. A2A = direct transfer. CARD_FUNDED = card-linked account. BNPL = buy now pay later. INSTANT_CREDIT = credit line.

placementId.description: Set to simulate a payment attributed to a placement (Premium merchants): the callback then carries the placementId

poiId.description: Set to simulate a POI sale: the callback then carries the poiId of the POI that created the transaction

productId.description: Set to simulate a payment that came from a product: the callback then carries the productId (from the product snapshot)

sessionId.description: Set to simulate a payment that came from an agent purchase session: the callback then carries the session's pa id

statusMessage.description: Custom status message for the transaction callback

tip.description: The payment's tip, a decimal string (e.g. '2.00'): the merchant's own, sent when it created the payment, or the payer's, added in their bank where the shop allows tips. Never a line: the callback carries it as tip, absent without one. With items the payer paid total + tip, so on CONFIRMED amount + fee = total + tip, and on any other status amount = total + tip.

tipEnteredBy.description: With tip: who entered it, MERCHANT (on create) or PAYER (in the bank app). Default PAYER. The callback carries it only with a tip.

transactionId.description: Transaction ID to simulate callback for

name: payware_operations_simulate_callback
